name: Suspension Biceps Curl
steps: Face a suspension trainer anchor, take an underhand grip on both handles, and lean back with straight arms and a rigid body.
Keep your elbows lifted slightly in front of your shoulders and brace your abs and glutes.
Flex your elbows smoothly to curl your hands toward your temples while squeezing your biceps hard.
Lower your body slowly back to straight arms without letting your elbows drop down to your sides.
tips: Hold your upper arms steady at shoulder height so your biceps drive the movement rather than your back.
Keep your body straight from heels to shoulders without swinging your hips forward.
